posts.title: swolectl: I wrote an open source controller for my Tonal
posts.description: Originally posted to r/tonalgym on Reddit . Hey folks, I started a project to provide a completely custom controller for the Tonal 1. This replaces the Android tablet and directly talks to the motor controller using the internal USB serial connection.
